rationale: CNP gapped down ~2.5% on elevated relative volume (6.5x) but is now trading in a tight range near the lower quarter of today's range, below VWAP ($40.69) and the 9-EMA ($40.67), with no clear directional momentum in the last five 1-minute candles (oscillating between $40.58–$40.69). The broad market is strongly risk-on today (SPY +1.51%, VIXY -8.11%), which creates a headwind for a short but the stock's persistent weakness relative to the market makes a long unattractive without a clear bounce catalyst. With no news and ambiguous price action, the risk/reward for either direction is insufficient to justify a new position alongside the existing short working order.
